feeds.description: ICS feed URLs, one per line (up to 10)
feeds.tooltip: One ICS or webcal address per line. Put a name and a vertical bar in front of an address to label that calendar. Lines starting with # are ignored.

refresh_minutes.tooltip: How often to re-download the calendar feeds.

http_timeout.tooltip: Give up on a feed that does not respond within this time.

show_feed_errors.description: Show a warning when a feed fails to load
show_feed_errors.tooltip: Displays a small notice rather than silently showing an incomplete day.

max_upcoming.tooltip: Events shown below the focused 'next' card. The list only ever covers the rest of today.

keep_ongoing.description: Treat an event happening right now as the focused event
keep_ongoing.tooltip: When on, an appointment already in progress stays in the spotlight until it ends.

show_all_day.tooltip: All-day events appear in a separate strip above the focused card.

hide_declined.tooltip: Skips events marked CANCELLED, and invitations you have declined.

hide_transparent.description: Hide events marked as free / not busy
hide_transparent.tooltip: Skips events with TRANSP:TRANSPARENT, which usually means 'does not block my time'.

show_location.tooltip: Displays the event location on the focused card when there is room.

show_calendar_name.description: Show which calendar an event came from
show_calendar_name.tooltip: The calendar's own name is read from the feed. If it does not publish one, the name you typed before the URL is used, and failing that the site it came from.

show_meeting_link.description: Show a join button for video meetings
show_meeting_link.tooltip: Finds the meeting link for Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex, Jitsi and others, and puts a join button on the focused card.

meeting_link_in_list.description: Also mark later meetings in the list
meeting_link_in_list.tooltip: Adds a small join button to upcoming events that have a video link.

meeting_lead_minutes.description: Only show the join button within
meeting_lead_minutes.tooltip: Hides the join button until the meeting is this close, so it appears when it is actually useful. Set to 0 to always show it.

show_countdown.description: Show a live countdown to the next event
show_countdown.tooltip: Ticks every ten seconds in the last minutes before an appointment, and less often when the day is quiet.

imminent_minutes.description: Flag an event as imminent when it starts within
imminent_minutes.tooltip: Imminent events get a brighter accent and a stronger glow. Set to 0 to disable.

desklet_width.tooltip: The layout adapts itself to this width: narrow widths switch to a compact single-column form, wide widths reveal more detail.

scale.tooltip: Scales every font size and spacing in the desklet.

show_header.tooltip: The line reading 'Today' with the date and remaining event count.

show_progress.description: Show a progress bar for an event in progress
show_progress.tooltip: A thin accent bar showing how far through the current appointment you are.

color_mode.tooltip: 'Position in the day' walks the rainbow down the list. 'Calendar feed' keeps each calendar a stable colour. 'Time of day' maps morning to evening across the spectrum.

surface_opacity.tooltip: Fluent acrylic works best somewhere between 0.55 and 0.85. Set to 0 for a fully transparent surface.

glow.description: Accent glow on the focused card
glow.tooltip: Soft neon bloom around the next appointment.

tint_surface.description: Tint surfaces with the accent colour
tint_surface.tooltip: Bleeds a trace of the event's neon colour into its card background.

dark_surface.tooltip: Turn off for a light acrylic surface with dark text.

calendar_command.tooltip: Command run when the desklet is clicked.
